newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian police arrest Norwegian bike gang leader.
newsitem.headline: Belgian police arrest Norwegian bike gang leader.

text.p: Belgian police have arrested the leader of a notorious Norwegian biker gang who has been wanted in the United States for the past 16 years for drug offences.
Thore Holm Hansen, 52, was arrested a week ago at Zaventem airport as he stepped off a flight from Oslo, a Brussels court spokesman said on Friday.
"Extradition procedings to the United States are under way. Normally it takes between one and a half and three months," he said.
Hansen, the leader of the 2,000 members of the European arm of the Outlaws motorcycle gang, was sentenced in the United States in 1981 to 60 years in prison for cocaine smuggling and other offences.
He skipped the country to Norway between the sentence being passed and actually beginning.
Norway does not extradite its nationals, and a spokeswoman for the Norwegian embassy in Brussels said he was not wanted for any crime in that country.
Hansen was wounded in the foot in January in a shootout between rival biker gangs who have been waging sporadic warfare against each other in the Nordic region.
When he was arrested at Zaventem airport on Friday night last week he was wearing a bullet-proof vest and carrying a return ticket to Oslo.
Belgian police have been keeping a close eye on the Nordic biker gangs who have shown signs of expanding their operational territory southwards into the Netherlands and Belgium.

Belgium has for years resisted the growing number of warring biker gangs that have steadily spread across Europe. But recently a number of these gangs has appeared in various parts of the country -- and they show every sign of spreading.
Gangs with names such as "Satans Jokers", "Gremlins" and "Lords" have been set up.
But the most recent has been the creation of the "MC Liege" gang in the eastern Belgian city of the same name.
Liege is known as the Palermo of the North because of its large Italian population and connections with organised crime.

Liege Socialist political patriarch Andre Cools was gunned down in July 1991 in a mafia-style hit. Five people were arrested last September in connection with the killing, and two alleged hit men are being held in Tunisia.
